examples.text: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedesiṃ.
yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno. handa dāni paṭisaṃharāmī'ti
akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti, paṭisaṃhareyyāsi tvaṃ, rāhula, evarūpaṃ kāyakammaṃ.

40907.meaning1: (of an arrow) to let down; to hold fire
40907.meaning2: (of an arrow) to put down; to withdraw

examples.text: tassa rājā okkāko, ko nevaṃ re ayaṃ mayhaṃ dāsiputto samāno maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yācatī'ti, kupito anattamano khurappaṃ sannayhi. so taṃ khurappaṃ n'eva asakkhi muñcituṃ, no paṭisaṃharituṃ.

40908.meaning2: having withdrawn, having removed, having folded

examples.text: phuṭṭhaphuṭṭhaṭṭhāne'y'eva pana gaṇento gaṇanāya ca phusanāya ca manasi karoti. tatth'eva gaṇanaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā te satiyā anubandhanto appanāvasena ca cittaṃ ṭhapento anubandhanāya ca phusanāya ca ṭhapanāya ca manasi karotī'ti vuccati.

40910.meaning1: tidying; putting away; setting in order

40911.meaning1: setting in order; clearing away; tidying up
40911.commentary: (MNa) pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā'ti, bhante, idaṃ me pattaṃ ṭhapetha, idaṃ cīvaraṃ, idaṃ thālakaṃ, idaṃ udakatumbaṃ, imaṃ kattarayaṭṭhin'ti evaṃ samaṇaparikkhāre saṅgopayamānā.

examples.text: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.

40913.meaning1: should be set in order; should be cleared away; should be tidied up
40913.meaningLit: to cause to be calm again

examples.text: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā. yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ appaṭighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.

40914.meaning1: sets in order; clears away; tidies up

examples.text: so āsanāni paṭisāmeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ paṭisāmeti, bhatt'aggaṃ sammajjati

40915.meaning2: having set in order, having kept away
40915.meaningLit: having caused to be calm again

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

40919.commentary: (PYt) paṭimukhaṃ attano dosaṃ sarāpetabbaṃ anena vinayakammenā'ti paṭisāraṇīyaṃ, tam'eva kammaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ.

40920.commentary: (PYt) paṭimukhaṃ attano dosaṃ sarāpetabbaṃ anena vinayakammenā'ti paṭisāraṇīyaṃ, tam'eva kammaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ.

40921.meaningLit: act of causing to be remembered
40921.commentary: (VBt) yena kammena akkuṭṭhagahaṭṭhasamaīpam'eva paṭisāriyati so akkosako pacchā pesiyati, taṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ nāma. (PYt) paṭimukhaṃ attano dosaṃ sarāpetabbaṃ anena vinayakammenā'ti paṭisāraṇīyaṃ, tam'eva kammaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ.

examples.text: tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu gihī akkosati paribhāsati. hand'assa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karomā'ti. te tassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karonti, adhammena vaggā.

40923.meaning1: falling back on; resorting to; relying on; valuing; placing value on

examples.text: khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.
āsādan'āpekkho'ti iminā imaṃ codessāmi sāressāmi paṭicodessāmi paṭisāressāmi maṅku karissāmī'ti abhiharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso kumbhakārapākā uṇhaṃ kumbhaṃ uddharitvā same bhūmibhāge paṭisisseyya.

40928.synonym: disa, paccatthika, paccāmitta, paṭisattu, paravādī, sattu
40928.commentary: (NIDD1) abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchan'ti. so gajjanto uggajjanto abhigajjanto eti upeti upagacchati paṭisūraṃ paṭipurisaṃ paṭisattuṃ paṭimallaṃ icchanto sādiyanto patthayanto pihayanto abhijappanto'ti, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ. (SNPa) tabhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchan'ti yathā so paṭisūraṃ icchanto abhigajjanto eti, evaṃ diṭṭhigatiko diṭṭhigatikan'ti dasseti.

examples.text: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

40931.meaning1: preventer; restrainer; who puts a stop to

examples.text: bhiyyo bālā pabhijjeyyuṃ, no c'assa paṭisedhako, tasmā bhusena daṇḍena, dhīro bālaṃ nisedhaye'ti.

40932.meaning1: preventing; restraining (of); putting a stop to

examples.text: etadeva ahaṃ maññe, bālassa paṭisedhanaṃ, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammatī'ti.

40935.meaning1: stops; puts an end to; prevents

examples.text: so manusse vadhitvā vadhitvā aṅgulīnaṃ mālaṃ dhāreti. t'āhaṃ, bhante, paṭisedhissāmī'ti.

40936.meaning1: to prevent; to obstruct; to oppose; to put a stop to

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, kim'atthiyā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā'ti? ye ca, bhante, koliyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ, yāni ca koliyānaṃ dūteyyāni tāni ca vahātuṃ, etadatthiyā, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā'ti.
sakkā nu kho paṭisedhetun'ti ca āvajjento, na sakkā paṭisedhetuṃ, theresu aparajjhitvā kālaṅ'kato ek'aṃsena padumaniraye nibbattissatī'ti disvā

40937.meaning2: having warded off, having prevented, having refused, having prohibited

40938.meaning2: warding off; preventing; prohibiting; refusing; rejecting

40940.meaning1: warned; prevented; prohibited; put a stop (to)

examples.text: bhagavā taṃ turitaturitaṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā'va āvajjento aññāsi, ayaṃ aggasāvake akkositu'kāmo āgato'ti. sakkā nu kho paṭisedhetun'ti ca āvajjento, na sakkā paṭisedhetuṃ, theresu aparajjhitvā kālaṅ'kato ek'aṃsena padumaniraye nibbattissatī'ti disvā, sāriputtamoggallāne'pi nāma garahantaṃ sutvā na nisedhetī'ti vādamocan'atthaṃ ariy'ūpavādassa ca mahāsāvajjabhāva-dassan'atthaṃ mā h'evan'ti tikkhattuṃ paṭisedhesi.

40941.commentary: (VINa) senā vā paṭisenāya ruddhā hotī'ti yathā sañcāro chijjati, evaṃ ruddhā hoti.

examples.text: anāpatti dvetisso rattiyo vasati, ūnakadvetisso rattiyo vasati, dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā pur'āruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati, gilāno vasati, gilānassa karaṇīyena vasati, senā vā paṭisenāya ruddhā hoti, kenaci palibuddho hoti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti
ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānaṃ, pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti.

40944.commentary: (ANa) na paṭisenetī'ti paṭiviruddho hutvā kalahabhaṇḍanavasena na ukkhipati.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosantaṃ paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭiseneti.

40945.synonym: anuyuñjati, āsevati, nisevati, yuñjati, samāpajjati, sevati

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ karoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo.
so vata, bhikkhave, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra kāmasaññāya aññatra kāmavitakkehi kāme paṭisevissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati, yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāva'd'eva hirikopīnappaṭicchādanatthaṃ
tañ'ca kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati, yassa patīto sumano, vipākaṃ paṭisevati.
dv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi. katame dve? attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, paṭisevato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso amussa kuṭṭhissa purisassa piheyya aṅgārakāsuyā vā bhesajjaṃ paṭisevanāya vā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

40950.meaning1: for indulging in that way; for that purpose

40951.meaning1: by using; through making use of
40951.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, paṭisevato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā
tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.
so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante. so tesaṃ na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, paṭisevato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā
visaṃ mā paṭisevittho, papātaṃ parivajjaya, paṅke ca mā visīdittho, yatto c'āsīvise care.

40956.meaning2: followed, pursued, practised, indulged in, used a medicine, etc.

examples.text: na kho maṃ, āvuso kassapa, evaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, imehi pana te, āvuso bākula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevito'ti. evañ'ca kho maṃ, āvuso kassapa, pucchitabbaṃ, imehi pana te, āvuso bākula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbā'ti?

40957.meaning1: to practise; to indulge; to engage (in)
40957.commentary: (ANa) n'āhaṃ bhabbo eta'r'ahi, kāmāni paṭisevitu nti ahaṃ dāni duvidhe'pi kāme paṭisevituṃ abhabbo.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ bhabbo eta'r'ahi, kāmāni paṭisevituṃ, anivatti bhavissāmi, brahmacariyaparāyaṇo'ti.
alaṃkammaniye'ti sakkā hoti methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ.

40958.meaning1: to use; to make use (of); to live (in)

examples.text: nekkhammavitakkena, abyāpādavitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, paññavā hoti ajaḷo anelamūgo, imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññavanappatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevitun'ti.

40959.meaning2: having followed, having pursued, having practised, having indulged in, having used a medicine, etc.

examples.text: antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti tiracchānagat'itthiyā'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo, pag'eva manuss'itthiyā. tena vuccati, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti.
pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathā'pi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sarīrabandhanena jīvituṃ, evam'eva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. tena vuccati, pārājiko hotī'ti.

40960.meaning2: following, pursuing, practising, indulging in, using a medicine, etc.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno sīt'odakapaṭikkhitto uṇh'odakapaṭisevī. so sīt'odakaṃ alabhamāno kālaṅ'kareyya. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto katth'ūpapattiṃ paññapetī'ti?

40962.grammar: inf of caus of pati √sev, caus, trans (+acc)
40962.meaning1: to practise; to engage; to indulge (in)

examples.text: abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ, abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātuṃ, abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevetuṃ, abhabbo khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ

40963.meaning1: upstream; against the current; against the flow

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? anusotagāmī puggalo, paṭisotagāmī puggalo, ṭhit'atto puggalo, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.

40964.meaning1: going upstream; headed against the current; going against the flow

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? anusotagāmī puggalo, paṭisotagāmī puggalo, ṭhit'atto puggalo, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca nappaṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena assumukho'pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭisotagāmī puggalo.

40965.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paṭisota
40965.meaning1: upstream; against the current; against the flow

examples.text: so tattha anusotam'pi vuyhati, paṭisotam'pi vuyhati, anusotapaṭisotam'pi vuyhati. so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
evaṃ khandhe avekkheyya, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo, divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ, sampajāno paṭissato.
na so rajjati dhammesu, dhammaṃ ñatvā paṭissato, virattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca n'ājjhosa tiṭṭhati.
atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati

40968.meaning1: measure of continuous mindfulness; degree of lucid self-awareness
40968.commentary: (DNa) atha kho yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya apar'āparaṃ uttaruttari ñāṇapamāṇ'atthāya c'eva satipamāṇ'atthāya ca, satisampajaññānaṃ vuḍḍh'atthāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati

40969.grammar: fem, comp, dat sg of paṭissatimattā
40969.meaning1: for a measure of continuous mindfulness; enough for a degree of lucid self-awareness
40969.meaning2: for a measure of continuous mindfulness; enough for lucid self-awareness

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. evam'pi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati.
n'āhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā, ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.

so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti. tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya. so upaṭṭhaheyya pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
sace me paṭissuṇāti upasampādemi, no ce me paṭissuṇāti na upasampādemi
yam'pi, bhikkhave, daliddo assako anāḷhiko iṇaṃ ādiyitvā vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇāti, vaḍḍhi'pi, bhikkhave, dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino'ti?
sacc'āhaṃ, ācariya, paṭissuṇiṃ, ap'āhaṃ marissāmi, n'āhaṃ sakkomi ekena passena sattamāse nipajjitun'ti
evaṃ, devā'ti kho jīvako komārabhacco rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissuṇitvā pañcamattāni hatthinikāsatāni kappāpetvā rañño ca ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ
sādhū'ti so tassā paṭissuṇitvā, akāsi kammaṃ tahiṃ vedanīyaṃ, katvāna kammaṃ tahiṃ vedanīyaṃ, upapajji so māṇavo tassā sahabyatan'ti.

40978.meaning1: having agreed (with); having responded in agreement (to); having assented (to)

examples.text: evam'āvuso'ti kho āyasmā thero tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbān'eva sarena abhaṇi.
evaṃ vutte, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tuṇhī bhavaṃ gotamo hotu, aham'eva tesaṃ sahadhammena paṭivacanaṃ karissāmī'ti.

40980.meaning1: should respond; would retort; could counter; should answer back

examples.text: sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānaṃ, pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti.

40981.meaning1: bends back; turns back; rolls back (from)

40982.meaning1: bends back onto itself; folds back
40982.commentary: (SNa) kappāsavaṭṭanakaraṇīyaṃ viya pavattento cirakālaṃ saṃvellitakilañjaṃ pasāretvā puna saṃvellento viya ca paṭivaṭṭeti nāma.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.
atha kho te licchavī ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ etadavocuṃ, kiṃ, je ambapāli, daharānaṃ daharānaṃ licchavīnaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ yugena yugaṃ paṭivaṭṭesī'ti?

40984.meaning1: to bend back onto itself; to fold back

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, bhabbo nu kho so puriso amuṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇetuṃ paṭikoṭṭetuṃ paṭivaṭṭetun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

40987.commentary: (SNa) paṭivattā'ti paṭippharitvā vattā, paṭippharitvā vā bālabalan'ti vadeyyā'pi, dhammaṭṭhaṃ pana cāletuṃ samattho nāma n'atthi.
